profile.headline: Senior Mobile Engineer | Architecting Resilient Cross-Platform Systems (iOS/Android/KMP)
profile.summary:
I specialize in building resilient, cross-platform mobile architectures that bridge the gap between complex data and high-performance user experiences. My career spans from launching 0-to-1 biomedical research platforms used globally to re-engineering core infrastructure for enterprise SaaS at Workday.

I am a firm believer in a mentor-first approach to engineering. I’ve found that by embedding architectural education into the development process, teams deliver more robust, high-quality solutions faster than working in silos. My goal is always to provide "technical leverage"—building the tools and foundations that elevate the entire team’s collective velocity.

Core Expertise:

* Languages & Frameworks: Swift (Concurrency/SwiftUI), Kotlin (KMP/Compose), Objective-C.
* Architecture: Use-Case/Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (DI) at scale, Reactive Systems.
* Systems Design: Thread-safe Telemetry & Metrics, Offline-first Data Persistence (SQLDelight), Cross-Platform Shared Logic.

Strategic Impact: Technical Mentorship, Automated Tooling/Code Generation, and Legacy Modernization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile)
positions.description:
Focused on multiplying "Technical Leverage" across the Workday iOS ecosystem. My role blends staff-level architecture, mentorship, and AI-native engineering—turning multi-quarter cross-org migrations into structured, repeatable workflows that move the codebase off legacy Objective-C and early Swift patterns into a modern, concurrency-safe architecture.

Key Initiatives:

* Agentic Refactoring & Developer Tooling: Building repository-aware AI skills, automated review guardrails, and step-by-step migration playbooks that let engineers (and AI agents) safely execute large-scale API migrations across hundreds of call sites.

* Strict Swift 6 Concurrency: Re-architecting foundational state, logging, and tenant-configuration layers to eliminate shared mutable state and unlock compile-time data-race safety across the dependency graph.

* Modern Authentication & Enterprise Policy Enforcement: Consolidating complex enterprise auth flows (OAuth PAR + PKCE, SSO, PIN, Biometrics) and unified app-protection policy gating into isolated, testable Swift packages.

* Pragmatic De-legacying: Designing zero-downtime migration paths—using protocol seams, dual-writes, and feature-toggle kill-switches—to decouple and delete decade-old singletons without disrupting feature delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Architecture · Kotlin · Swift (Programming Language)

positions.title: Technical Advisor (Volunteer) | Digital Health Research
positions.description: Providing pro bono architectural guidance and legacy migration support to the research community following the transition from Sage Bionetworks. Mentoring students and ensuring the continuity of global biomedical research frameworks.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · SwiftUI · Kotlin · React.js

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer | Mobile & Systems Architecture
positions.description:
Led the technical evolution of a global SaaS platform, architecting the mobile frameworks and cross-platform services used by research scientists to conduct large-scale biomedical studies.

- Platform Innovation: Engineered an open-source, polymorphic JSON architecture that replaced industry standards (ResearchKit/Stack), enabling cross-platform UI synchronization across iOS, Android, and Web.

- 0-to-1 Product Delivery: Spearheaded the end-to-end development of 8+ mission-critical applications, including a custom Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) framework for AWS integration and offline-first data persistence.

- Deep Tech Integration: Designed specialized frameworks for high-fidelity data collection, managing complex UI/UX while handling background processing for location, motion, and biometric sensors.

- Legacy Modernization: Orchestrated the transition of legacy Objective-C/UIKit codebases to modern Swift/SwiftUI architectures to improve performance and developer velocity.

- Team Mentorship: Scaled the engineering culture by mentoring junior developers and implementing rigorous CI/CD, unit testing, and documentation standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Architecture · Technical Design · Kotlin · Swift (Programming Language) · Software Design · Mobile Applications · SwiftUI

positions.title: Sr. Software and Controls Engineer
positions.description: Developed a Lego-based robot with remote control and autopilot modes. Used Arduino and C++ to control the servo motors and a rangefinder. The motor controller communicates with the iOS app written in Swift using BLE 4.0.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Fluke’s iPhone BLE application. Redesign of the architecture used to perform BLE communication with assorted measurement equipment, each designed with different communication protocols and data structures. Migrated the web services from AF Networking 1.0 to 2.5, including changes to the Core Data architecture to use current best-practices. Various improvements to the performance and robustness of the overall project. Worked with a team based in India to transfer project knowledge to Fluke’s in-house team of developers.

company.name: Fluke Corporation, Subcontract through Dogfish Software

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Project work included iCloud-backed Core Data, MapKit, SpriteKit, and custom view layouts and transitions. Championed the use of GitHub and JIRA to manage projects and using the XCTest framework to develop projects with TDD principles.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer on award-winning iPad and iPhone applications for a major retail chain. Designed and built a custom view controller hierarchy based conceptually on a tab view controller, including custom animations and layout. The architecture we created for iOS 3 was similar to the parenting view controller and collection view classed introduced by Apple in future iOS versions.

projects.title: JsonModel-Swift
projects.description:
https://github.com/BridgeDigitalHealth/JsonModel-Swift

JsonModel is a set of utilities built on top of the Swift Codable protocol to allow for polymorphic serialization and documentation using a subset of JSON Schema draft 7.
